scope: Every mathematical assertion in arXiv:1601.07580v1, including background, remarks, unnumbered displays, intermediate proof assertions and both appendices.
completion_rule: Every mathematical passage must receive complete semantic decomposition, exact-domain correspondence and validated declarations, or a proved counterexample plus corrected replacement.
